info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Utility Billing Plans-v1-spec
info.description: This API allows users to access a comprehensive list of utility billing plans offered by the service. Typical consumers include utility companies and service providers looking to display or analyze available billing options. Users can retrieve detailed information on each billing plan, including features, pricing, and eligibility criteria. This functionality supports decision-making for customers selecting suitable billing options for their utilities. The endpoint serves as a valuable resource for integrating utility billing information into applications and platforms.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of the current billing plan for a user. It provides in-depth information regarding the plan's features, pricing, and other relevant attributes.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the current billing plan information. This body is expected to contain the necessary parameters to specify the desired plan details from the billing system.

ListUtilityBillingPlansRequest.description: This schema represents the request body for the GET operation related to billing plans, formatted as a JSON string.
